final: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), bucket_shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, 1.0 * bucket_count / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), scored AS (SELECT bucket_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM bucket_shares) SELECT SUM(bucket_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM scored WHERE share > average_share
